description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Impose Special Commodity Levy for the other - Potatoes. This order is valid until 31.12.2024
categorisation: This gazette notification imposes a Special Commodity Levy on potatoes under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007. It falls under Legal/Regulatory classification as it involves the exercise of statutory powers to create a regulatory measure (tax/levy) through subsidiary legislation, which is a characteristic of Type 5 gazettes dealing with regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements. While it mentions a minister's name, this is incidental to the regulatory action being taken rather than constituting a personnel appointment with detailed portfolio responsibilities.
